# D's Pool Care Inc. (We Clean Pools)

> Weekly pool service, one-time cleans, equipment repairs and pool remodels in Arlington, Texas, and around Dallas–Fort Worth. Founded in the spring of 1999 by Dallas Dodson, then a rookie police officer, who still runs it as an off-duty police officer. Certified Pool Operator; Texas Residential Appliance Installer license TICL 410 (verifiable with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation). Phone (817) 845-3533, Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM Central Time.

## Services and prices

- [Weekly service](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#weekly): from $185 a month. Every visit: chemical treatment, vacuuming with electric Power Vacs, steps brushed, leaves removed, skimmer baskets emptied, automatic pool sweep cleaned and checked, backwash as needed, all equipment checked. Filter cleans are extra. Free estimate.
- [Drain, clean and acid wash](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#prices): from $595. Debris removed, surface and tile pressure-washed, plaster acid-washed, optional chemical start-up after the refill.
- [Spring clean](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#prices): one-time clean-up of a neglected or green pool. Free estimate.
- [Filter clean](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#prices): DE filter $150 plus tax, cartridge filter $125 plus tax.
- [Tile cleaning](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#prices): calcium removed from the water line by low-pressure bead blasting with Maxx Strip (no silica, no toxic metals, no acid). Full or empty pool. Free estimate.
- [Repairs](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#repairs): pumps and motors, filter systems, pool cleaners, plumbing leaks, timers, salt systems, Deck-O-Seal.
- [Remodels](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#remodels): new plaster, new tile, new coping, custom additions. Firm estimate by email within 24 hours of the visit; 10 to 14 days of work on average. Remodel site: https://www.weremodelpools.com/
- [Pool School](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#estimate): lessons for pool owners in routine cleaning, water chemistry and equipment care.

## Company

- [About Dallas Dodson](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#dallas): born and raised in Arlington; family owned, licensed and insured, not a franchise.
- [Reviews](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#reviews): customer testimonials; more on Google.
- [Free estimate](https://www.wecleanpools.com/#estimate): phone (817) 845-3533, email Dallasdodson77@wecleanpools.com.
